- Nutmeg and the Tiny Gift: ages 3-5, 12 passes, big print
- The Wiggly Sleigh Ride: ages 5-7, 22 passes
- The Great Gingerbread Mix-Up: ages 6-9, 28 passes

WHAT MAKES IT EASY TO HOST

How to Play – Left Right Christmas Game 🎁

This is a fun and easy Christmas gift-passing game for kids, families, and classroom parties!

Step 1: Get Everyone Ready

Grab one wrapped gift and ask everyone to sit in a circle. Make sure each player can easily reach the person sitting next to them.

Step 2: Choose a Story

Pick one of the six Christmas or winter stories. Have an adult or a confident reader read it aloud while everyone else listens.

Step 3: Start Passing the Gift

Give the wrapped gift to one player to start. As the story is read, listen carefully for the words LEFT and RIGHT.

When you hear LEFT, pass the gift to the person on your left.

When you hear RIGHT, pass the gift to the person on your right.

Every time you hear either word, pass the gift once in that direction.

Step 4: Keep Listening!

The gift will move around the circle as the story continues. Pay attention because the direction can change at any moment!

Step 5: Find Out Who Wins!

When the story ends, everyone stops passing. Whoever is holding the gift gets to keep it!

A Few Helpful Tips

Read slowly enough for everyone to follow along.

Try a quick practice round before starting, especially with younger children.

Use the shorter stories for little kids and the longer ones for older children or family gatherings.

The host can use the included cheat sheet to check the passing order.

Want to play again? Choose another story and start with a different player!

Most importantly, have fun and enjoy the Christmas surprise!
